Implement rate limiting on POST /api/login in routes/auth.js: max 5 attempts per minute per IP, return 429 with Retry-After header, must not affect other endpoints, and keep the existing success flow and tests green.

Refactor src/services/payment.ts to extract the Stripe-specific logic into src/providers/stripe.ts behind a PaymentProvider interface — same public API, all 34 existing tests must stay green, no new dependencies.

Debug the intermittent 502 on /checkout: nginx logs show upstream timeout after 30s, app logs show the order INSERT committing. Reproduce with scripts/load-test.sh, find the blocking call, fix it without raising the nginx timeout.

Migrate the user table from serial IDs to UUIDs: write the migration in db/migrations/, keep both columns during rollout, update models/user.py and all foreign keys, zero downtime — describe the rollout order before writing code.

Build a CSV export for the orders dashboard: new endpoint GET /api/orders/export streaming rows (up to 500k), respect the current filters from query params, RFC 4180 quoting, and add one integration test that checks a quoted field.

Implementa cache Redis nas consultas de produto em services/catalog.js: TTL 5 minutos, invalidar no update de produto, fallback silencioso pra DB se o Redis cair, sem mudar a assinatura das funções existentes.

Corrige a race condition no worker de emails em workers/mailer.py: dois workers pegam o mesmo job quando o SELECT e o UPDATE não são atômicos. Usa SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, mantém o retry atual e adiciona um teste que prova o lock.

Adiciona paginação por cursor no endpoint GET /api/posts em routes/posts.js: cursor opaco base64 de (created_at,id), page size máximo 100, deve manter compatibilidade com clientes que ainda mandam ?page=, e documenta no README da API.
